entities.name: Query protein, 344 aa
observations: Sequence is 344 aa and matches reviewed Corynebacterium glutamicum aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase P0C1D8 at 74.7% identity with 100% query and target coverage (E=1.13e-176).
Strong homology supports aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase activity (EC 1.2.1.11): NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate-semialdehyde.

Likely participates in aspartate-family amino-acid biosynthesis, including lysine, methionine, and threonine biosynthesis; inferred from curated homolog annotations, not established experimentally for this query.
